Write the GitHub release notes for Lumen {tag}, Columen Labs' open-source building blocks for apps, published to npm as @columenlabs/lumen-ui (React components), @columenlabs/lumen-ui-types (its view model types) and @columenlabs/lumen-ship (release notes, the What's new changelog and lint guards). It covers the merged pull requests (or commits) below.
Start with '## Key takeaways': 3 to 5 bullets, each opening with one or more type tags from [Feature] [Improvement] [Fix] [Performance] [Security] [Breaking] (e.g. '- [Feature] **Headline**: sentence'), then a bold one-line headline, then one plain sentence on what a developer using Lumen can now do.
Write each bullet for a developer who has never seen the change: the sentence must say where it lives, by the package, the exported part and the prop, option, slot or command they would use (e.g. 'In LumenView, the new `pivot` option ...', 'LumenChart's `indicators` prop now ...', 'From @columenlabs/lumen-ui-types/views, `customViewConfigSchema` ...', '`lumen-ship release` now ...'). A [Breaking] bullet says what to change in an app.
Then one '## <area>' section per area touched (Shell, Layout and widgets, Tables and views, Charts, Pickers and forms, Types, Theme, Shipping, Docs, Tooling), a few short bullets each in plain words, merging related pull requests.
This repo is public and Lumen names no product: never name an app, product or company that uses it, even if a pull request does; say 'an app' instead. No PR numbers, no file paths, no vendor names. Output only the markdown.
